# Slash commands

Commands typed in a chat, starting with `/`. Names and aliases ignore case. `/help` lists the ones the current surface offers.

## Session

| Command | Aliases | Arguments | What it does | Offered in |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `/new` | `/reset` | `[name] [now\|-y]` | Start a fresh session; add a name to title it, 'now' or -y to skip the question | everywhere |
| `/clear` |  |  | Clear the screen and start a fresh session | classic CLI, TUI |
| `/history` |  |  | Show this conversation so far | classic CLI, TUI |
| `/title` |  | `[name]` | Show or set the title of this session | everywhere |
| `/resume` |  | `[name\|number]` | Switch to an earlier session by title, id or list number | everywhere |
| `/sessions` |  | `[name\|number]` | List recent sessions to pick one to resume | everywhere |
| `/retry` |  |  | Take back your last message and send it again | everywhere |
| `/undo` |  | `[N]` | Take back your last N messages and their replies (default 1) | everywhere |
| `/save` |  | `json\|md\|html [file] (json, md, html)` | Write this conversation to a file as JSON lines, Markdown or HTML | everywhere |
| `/branch` | `/fork` | `[name]` | Copy this conversation into a new session and continue there | everywhere |
| `/stop` |  |  | Stop the running reply and this session's background processes | everywhere |
| `/steer` | `/s` | `<text>` | Add guidance to the running reply after its next tool call | everywhere |
| `/queue` | `/q` | `<text>\|add <text>\|list\|clear\|rm N (add, list, clear, rm)` | Line up a message for after the current reply; list, clear or remove queued ones | everywhere |
| `/compress` | `/compact` | `[focus]` | Summarise older turns to free context | everywhere |
| `/status` |  |  | Show the session, model and approval state | everywhere |
| `/context` | `/ctx` |  | Show how much of the context window is in use | everywhere |
| `/btw` |  | `<question>` | Ask a side question without changing the conversation | everywhere |
| `/goal` |  | `<objective> [--max-turns N] [--gate "cmd"]\|status\|pause\|resume\|clear (status, pause, resume, clear)` | Set a standing goal the agent keeps working towards | everywhere |
| `/subgoal` |  | `add <text>\|done N\|list (add, done, list)` | Add, tick off or list extra criteria of the current goal | everywhere |
| `/loop` | `/proactive` | `<interval\|auto> <prompt> [--times N] [--until "condition"]\|list\|stop [id] (list, stop, resume, auto)` | Repeat a prompt in this session on an interval | everywhere |
| `/heartbeat` | `/hb` | `every <interval> <prompt>\|list\|pause [id]\|resume [id]\|stop [id] (every, list, pause, resume, stop)` | Send a recurring prompt into this session while it is idle | everywhere |
| `/moa` |  | `[preset] <prompt>\|on [preset]\|off\|status (on, off, status)` | Answer with the advice of several models (this prompt, or on/off for the session) | everywhere |
| `/agents` | `/tasks` |  | Show running helper agents and background tasks | everywhere |
| `/refine` |  | `[focus]` | Review this conversation now and keep what was learned | everywhere |
| `/journey` | `/learning` | `[list\|delete <id>\|edit <id>] (list, delete, edit)` | Browse what the agent has learned over time | classic CLI, TUI |
| `/rollback` |  | `[N [file]\|diff N\|--all] (diff)` | List or restore file checkpoints | everywhere |
| `/worktree` |  | `[list\|new [name]\|prune [--dry-run]] (list, new, prune)` | Create, list or prune isolated git worktrees | classic CLI |
| `/approve` |  | `[session\|always]` | Approve the command waiting for an answer | messaging |
| `/deny` |  | `[reason]` | Refuse the command waiting for an answer | messaging |
| `/bg` | `/background` | `<prompt>` | Run a prompt in a separate background session and post the result here | messaging |

## Settings

| Command | Aliases | Arguments | What it does | Offered in |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `/model` |  | `[provider:model] [--provider name] [--global]` | Show or switch the model; --global also saves it | everywhere |
| `/reasoning` |  | `[level\|show\|hide] [--global] (none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max, ultra, show, hide)` | Show or set reasoning effort, or show/hide reasoning text | everywhere |
| `/yolo` |  |  | Turn auto-approval of risky commands on or off for this session | everywhere |
| `/approvals` |  | `[manual\|smart\|off] (manual, smart, off)` | Show or save how risky commands are approved | everywhere |
| `/fast` |  | `[normal\|fast\|auto\|status] [--global] (normal, fast, auto, status)` | Ask the provider for faster processing | everywhere |
| `/config` |  |  | Show the effective settings with secrets masked | classic CLI, TUI |
| `/sethome` |  |  | Make this chat the home channel for scheduled results and notices | messaging |
| `/platform` |  | `[list\|pause\|resume] [name] (list, pause, resume)` | List messaging platforms, or pause / resume one | messaging |
| `/verbose` |  | `[off\|new\|all\|verbose] (off, new, all, verbose)` | Change how much tool activity this chat shows | messaging |
| `/personality` |  | `[name]` | Show or pick the agent's personality | messaging |
| `/voice` |  | `[on\|off\|status] (on, off, status)` | Turn voice input and spoken replies on or off | everywhere |

## Tools and skills

| Command | Aliases | Arguments | What it does | Offered in |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `/tools` |  | `[list\|enable\|disable] [name...] (list, enable, disable)` | List tools, or enable/disable toolsets (starts a fresh session) | classic CLI, TUI |
| `/skills` |  | `[list\|view\|reload\|pending\|approve\|reject\|search\|install] [name\|id\|query] (list, view, reload, pending, approve, reject, search, install)` | Find, install and manage skills | everywhere |
| `/reload-skills` |  |  | Rescan skill folders and refresh skill commands (the prompt stays as it is) | everywhere |
| `/bundles` |  |  | List skill bundles (each runs as its own /command) | everywhere |
| `/memory` |  | `[pending\|approve\|reject\|approval\|status] [id\|all\|on\|off] (pending, approve, reject, approval, status)` | Review memory writes waiting for approval | everywhere |
| `/learn` |  | `<what to learn from>` | Turn something you describe into a reusable skill | everywhere |
| `/curator` |  | `[status\|run\|pause\|resume] (status, run, pause, resume)` | Background upkeep of skills | everywhere |
| `/browser` |  | `[connect <cdp-url>\|disconnect\|status\|use local] (connect, disconnect, status, use)` | Connect the browser tools to a running browser | classic CLI, TUI |
| `/checkpoints` |  | `[on\|off\|status] (on, off, status)` | Turn file checkpoints on or off | everywhere |
| `/mcp` |  |  | Show connected MCP servers | everywhere |
| `/reload-mcp` | `/reload_mcp` |  | Reconnect MCP servers from the config | everywhere |
| `/plugins` |  | `[list\|enable\|disable] [name] (list, enable, disable)` | List plugins, or enable/disable one for this profile | classic CLI, TUI |
| `/cron` |  | `[subcommand]` | Manage scheduled jobs | classic CLI, TUI |
| `/suggestions` |  | `[list\|accept\|dismiss\|refresh] [n] (list, accept, dismiss, refresh)` | List suggested jobs; accept or dismiss one | everywhere |
| `/blueprint` |  | `[name] [slot=value ...]` | Set up a job from a blueprint; with no name, list them | everywhere |
